model.olist_silver.fact_ventas.description: Grano: Artículo individual de una orden.
model.olist_silver.fact_ventas.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table') }}
with oi as (select * from {{ ref('stg_olist__order_items') }}),
o as (select * from {{ ref('stg_olist__orders') }})
select
 oi.order_id, oi.order_item_id, md5(oi.product_id) product_key, md5(oi.seller_id) seller_key,
 md5(o.customer_id) customer_key,
 to_number(to_char(o.order_purchase_timestamp,'YYYYMMDD')) date_key,
 c.geography_key geography_key,
 md5(o.order_status) order_status_key,
 1 cantidad_articulos, oi.price precio, oi.freight_value flete,
 oi.price + oi.freight_value valor_articulo,
 o.order_purchase_timestamp fecha_venta
from oi join o on oi.order_id=o.order_id
left join (
  select dc.*, dg.geography_key
  from {{ ref('dim_customer') }} dc
  left join {{ ref('dim_geography') }} dg on dg.codigo_postal=dc.codigo_postal
) c on c.customer_id=o.customer_id

model.olist_silver.dim_channel.name: dim_channel
model.olist_silver.dim_channel.compiled_code:
with x as (
 select distinct channel as canal from OLIST_SYNTHETIC_V2.silver.stg_marketing_campaigns__campaign_events
 union select distinct channel from OLIST_SYNTHETIC_V2.silver.stg_marketing_campaigns__campaign_channels
 union select distinct ticket_channel from OLIST_SYNTHETIC_V2.silver.stg_customer_service__service_tickets
 union select distinct channel from OLIST_SYNTHETIC_V2.silver.stg_customer_service__ticket_interactions
 union select distinct origin from OLIST_SYNTHETIC_V2.silver.stg_marketing_funnel__mql
 union select 'UNKNOWN'
)
select md5(upper(trim(canal))) channel_key, upper(trim(canal)) nombre_canal,
       case when upper(trim(canal)) in ('EMAIL','E-MAIL') then 'EMAIL'
            when upper(trim(canal)) in ('SOCIAL','SOCIAL_MEDIA') then 'SOCIAL'
            when upper(trim(canal)) in ('PHONE','TELEFONO') then 'PHONE'
            when upper(trim(canal)) in ('UNKNOWN','SIN_DATO') then 'UNKNOWN'
            else upper(trim(canal)) end grupo_canal,
       case when upper(trim(canal)) in ('EMAIL','E-MAIL','SOCIAL','SOCIAL_MEDIA') then 'digital'
            else 'servicio' end modalidad
from x where canal is not null

model.olist_silver.dim_date.name: dim_date
model.olist_silver.dim_date.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table') }}
with bounds as (
    select
      least(to_date('2016-01-01'), min(d)) as min_date,
      greatest(to_date('2027-12-31'), max(d)) as max_date
    from (
      select to_date(order_purchase_timestamp) d from {{ ref('stg_olist__orders') }}
      union all select to_date(snapshot_date) from {{ ref('stg_erp_inventory__inventory') }}
      union all select to_date(metric_date) from {{ ref('stg_marketing_campaigns__campaign_daily_metrics') }}
      union all select to_date(ticket_date) from {{ ref('stg_customer_service__service_tickets') }}
      union all select to_date(transaction_date) from {{ ref('stg_finance__payment_transactions') }}
    )
), spine as (
    select dateadd(day, seq4(), b.min_date) date_day
    from bounds b, table(generator(rowcount => 5000))
    where dateadd(day, seq4(), b.min_date) <= b.max_date
)
select
  to_number(to_char(date_day,'YYYYMMDD')) as date_key,
  date_day as fecha,
  day(date_day) as dia,
  dayname(date_day) as nombre_dia,
  weekofyear(date_day) as semana,
  month(date_day) as mes,
  monthname(date_day) as nombre_mes,
  quarter(date_day) as trimestre,
  iff(month(date_day)<=6,1,2) as semestre,
  year(date_day) as ano,
  iff(dayofweekiso(date_day)>=6,true,false) as indicador_fin_de_semana,
  -- Columnas añadidas para Power BI (nombres en español + columnas de orden)
  dayofweekiso(date_day) as num_dia_semana,   -- 1 = lunes ... 7 = domingo (ordena nombre_dia_es)
  decode(dayofweekiso(date_day), 1,'Lunes', 2,'Martes', 3,'Miércoles', 4,'Jueves',
         5,'Viernes', 6,'Sábado', 7,'Domingo') as nombre_dia_es,
  decode(month(date_day), 1,'Enero', 2,'Febrero', 3,'Marzo', 4,'Abril', 5,'Mayo', 6,'Junio',
         7,'Julio', 8,'Agosto', 9,'Septiembre', 10,'Octubre', 11,'Noviembre', 12,'Diciembre') as nombre_mes_es,
  to_char(date_day,'YYYY-MM') as mes_anio
from spine

model.olist_silver.dim_geography.name: dim_geography
model.olist_silver.dim_geography.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table') }}
with g as (
 select distinct geolocation_zip_code_prefix as codigo_postal, geolocation_city as ciudad,
        geolocation_state as estado, geolocation_lat as latitud, geolocation_lng as longitud
 from {{ ref('stg_olist__geolocation') }}
),
base as (
 select codigo_postal, ciudad, estado, latitud, longitud from g
 union
 select customer_zip_code_prefix, customer_city, customer_state, null, null
 from {{ ref('stg_olist__customers') }}
 union
 select seller_zip_code_prefix, seller_city, seller_state, null, null
 from {{ ref('stg_olist__sellers') }}
)
select md5(concat_ws('|',coalesce(codigo_postal::varchar,''),coalesce(ciudad,''),coalesce(estado,''))) geography_key,
       codigo_postal, ciudad, estado, 'Brasil' as pais,
       case when estado in ('SP','RJ','MG','ES') then 'Sudeste'
            when estado in ('PR','SC','RS') then 'Sul'
            when estado in ('BA','PE','CE','MA','PB','RN','AL','SE','PI') then 'Nordeste'
            when estado in ('GO','MT','MS','DF') then 'Centro-Oeste'
            when estado in ('AM','PA','AC','RO','RR','AP','TO') then 'Norte'
            else 'Sin clasificar' end as region,
       latitud, longitud
from base
qualify row_number() over (
  partition by codigo_postal
  order by case when latitud is not null then 0 else 1 end, ciudad
)=1

model.olist_silver.dim_payment.description: Una clasificación de pago (conformada entre Olist y Payment Gateway)
model.olist_silver.dim_payment.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table') }}
-- Dim_Pago es una dimensión conformada compartida por Fact_Pagos (Olist) y
-- Fact_Transacciones_Pasarela (Payment Gateway). Se unen ambas fuentes para
-- evitar payment_key huérfanas cuando la pasarela reporta combinaciones
-- tipo/cuotas que Olist nunca genera (bug detectado en revisión).
with olist_pagos as (
 select distinct payment_type as tipo_pago, payment_installments as cuotas
 from {{ ref('stg_olist__order_payments') }}
),
gateway_pagos as (
 select distinct payment_type_source as tipo_pago, installments as cuotas
 from {{ ref('stg_payment_gateway__gateway_transactions') }}
),
x as (
 select * from olist_pagos
 union
 select * from gateway_pagos
)
select md5(concat_ws('|',coalesce(tipo_pago,''),coalesce(cuotas::varchar,''))) payment_key,
       tipo_pago as tipo, tipo_pago as metodo, cuotas as condicion_cuotas,
       case when tipo_pago in ('credit_card','debit_card') then 'tarjeta'
            when tipo_pago='boleto' then 'efectivo_boleto'
            when tipo_pago='voucher' then 'voucher'
            when tipo_pago='pix' then 'pago_instantaneo' else 'otro' end categoria
from x

model.olist_silver.fact_logistica.name: fact_logistica
model.olist_silver.fact_logistica.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table') }}
with s as (select * from {{ ref('stg_logistics_tms__shipments') }}),
o as (select * from {{ ref('stg_olist__orders') }})
select
 s.shipment_id, s.order_id, md5(s.seller_id) seller_key, md5(s.customer_id) customer_key,
 case when s.carrier_id is null then null else md5(concat('TMS|',s.carrier_id)) end carrier_key,
 -- Nota: en Snowflake, concat/|| ya propaga NULL automáticamente (a diferencia de otros motores
 -- donde NULL se trata como cadena vacía), por lo que carrier_key ya salía NULL correctamente
 -- cuando carrier_id es NULL (~1.3% de envíos sin transportista documentado, ver data_quality_report.md).
 -- Se deja este CASE WHEN explícito por legibilidad y como salvaguarda ante un futuro cambio de motor.
 md5(s.route_id) route_key,
 to_number(to_char(s.shipment_date,'YYYYMMDD')) date_key,
 s.status estado_envio,
 datediff(day,o.order_purchase_timestamp,s.shipment_date) dias_preparacion,
 datediff(day,s.shipment_date,s.actual_delivery_date) dias_transito,
 datediff(day,o.order_purchase_timestamp,s.actual_delivery_date) dias_entrega_total,
 greatest(datediff(day,s.estimated_delivery_date,s.actual_delivery_date),0) dias_retraso,
 s.shipping_cost costo_envio,
 iff(s.actual_delivery_date is not null and s.actual_delivery_date<=s.estimated_delivery_date,1,0) indicador_entrega_a_tiempo,
 s.package_weight peso_paquete, s.package_volume volumen_paquete,
 s.shipment_date fecha_envio, s.estimated_delivery_date fecha_estimada_entrega, s.actual_delivery_date fecha_entrega
from s left join o on s.order_id=o.order_id

macro.dbt_snowflake.snowflake__get_catal.macro_sql:
{% macro snowflake__get_catalog_tables_sql(information_schema) -%}
    select
        table_catalog as "table_database",
        table_schema as "table_schema",
        table_name as "table_name",
        case
            when is_dynamic = 'YES' and table_type = 'BASE TABLE' THEN 'DYNAMIC TABLE'
            else table_type
        end as "table_type",
        comment as "table_comment",

        -- note: this is the _role_ that owns the table
        table_owner as "table_owner",

        'Clustering Key' as "stats:clustering_key:label",
        clustering_key as "stats:clustering_key:value",
        'The key used to cluster this table' as "stats:clustering_key:description",
        (clustering_key is not null) as "stats:clustering_key:include",

        'Row Count' as "stats:row_count:label",
        row_count as "stats:row_count:value",
        'An approximate count of rows in this table' as "stats:row_count:description",
        (row_count is not null) as "stats:row_count:include",

        'Approximate Size' as "stats:bytes:label",
        bytes as "stats:bytes:value",
        'Approximate size of the table as reported by Snowflake' as "stats:bytes:description",
        (bytes is not null) as "stats:bytes:include",

        'Last Modified' as "stats:last_modified:label",
        to_varchar(convert_timezone('UTC', last_altered), 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI'||'UTC') as "stats:last_modified:value",
        'The timestamp for last update/change' as "stats:last_modified:description",
        (last_altered is not null and table_type in ('BASE TABLE', 'INTERACTIVE TABLE')) as "stats:last_modified:include"
    from {{ information_schema }}.tables
{%- endmacro %}

macro.dbt_snowflake.snowflake__get_catal.name: snowflake__get_catalog_columns_sql
macro.dbt_snowflake.snowflake__get_catal.macro_sql:
{% macro snowflake__get_catalog_columns_sql(information_schema) -%}
    select
        table_catalog as "table_database",
        table_schema as "table_schema",
        table_name as "table_name",

        column_name as "column_name",
        ordinal_position as "column_index",
        data_type as "column_type",
        comment as "column_comment"
    from {{ information_schema }}.columns
{%- endmacro %}

doc.dbt.__overview__.block_contents:
### Welcome!

Welcome to the auto-generated documentation for your dbt project!

### Navigation

You can use the `Project` and `Database` navigation tabs on the left side of the window to explore the models
in your project.

#### Project Tab
The `Project` tab mirrors the directory structure of your dbt project. In this tab, you can see all of the
models defined in your dbt project, as well as models imported from dbt packages.

#### Database Tab
The `Database` tab also exposes your models, but in a format that looks more like a database explorer. This view
shows relations (tables and views) grouped into database schemas. Note that ephemeral models are _not_ shown
in this interface, as they do not exist in the database.

### Graph Exploration
You can click the blue icon on the bottom-right corner of the page to view the lineage graph of your models.

On model pages, you'll see the immediate parents and children of the model you're exploring. By clicking the `Expand`
button at the top-right of this lineage pane, you'll be able to see all of the models that are used to build,
or are built from, the model you're exploring.

Once expanded, you'll be able to use the `--select` and `--exclude` model selection syntax to filter the
models in the graph. For more information on model selection, check out the [dbt docs](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/model-selection-syntax).

Note that you can also right-click on models to interactively filter and explore the graph.

---
